items.title: Simon flooding and landslides hit riverside communities in Michoacán and Colima
items.summary: AFP Monday wrap: flooding and landslides had already hit communities close to rivers and streams in Michoacán and Colima. Simon weakened to Cat 2, did not make landfall, and was moving away from the coast; a rain alert remains in place and officials warn waves up to 5 meters high are still expected in some coastal areas. CNPC's latest: Simon will hit Mazatlán, Sinaloa as a Category 1 hurricane; Puerto Vallarta awoke to clear skies Monday. Five-death toll unchanged (1 Simon/Guerrero, 4 Rachel/Baja).

items.title: Florida co-ops: ~36,000 members out Monday AM; CHELCO's largest storm response ever
items.summary: NRECA/electric.coop (updated 11 a.m. ET Mon): ~36,000 Florida co-op members still out early Monday, most of them ~20,000 in CHELCO's coastal areas; CHELCO CEO expects nearly all members back by Tuesday evening (~96h after landfall), calling it 'the largest storm response in CHELCO's history'; 15 of 16 CHELCO substations reenergized. 250,000 co-op members in the dark at peak across FL/GA/AL/MS. Alabama co-ops: ~8,000 members out Monday AM (down from 103,000 peak); Baldwin EMC fully restored Sunday.
